title: pm-dispatch SKILL.md claim template gains the `Premise:` line the pre-dispatch check writes (needs a ruled 318 → 319 raise)
body:
Filing gate **③**: a follow-up owed by landing work. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287) from the contract review of PR #25658 (card #25490), which accepted deferring this line only with a named carrier. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade suggested S, p3; triage may regrade.

## Business rationale

- **Who benefits:** every seat that dispatches a card-thread card. #25552 made the seat verify a card's premise before dispatch and land the reading on a `Premise:` claim line (`dispatch-runbook.md` L154 「读数落认领 `Premise:` 行」), but the claim template in `SKILL.md` 〈模板与表〉 has no such line, so seats copying the template drop it.
- **Cost of not doing it:** the premise reading lives only in free comments; a dev thread or reviewer cannot find it at a fixed key.

## Reader (who acts)

The `domain:skills` seat, in-seat, one line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` plus its ceiling row in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`.

## Wanted

One template line after `Thread-read:`, e.g. `Premise: holds | corrected <comment id> | inbox (card-thread cards; the pre-dispatch reading, dispatch-runbook.md 派发前置)`. `SKILL.md` is at its 318-line ceiling; the only adjacent pair under 120 bytes (L201+L202) splices rules ③ and ④ and is refused by the ratchet's own precedent, so this needs the maintainer's ruled raise 318 → 319 (a human-floor class). The seat asks for it before editing.

## Acceptance

- The template carries the line; `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` (318 → 319, the row citing the ruling), `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-frame-freshness` green.
- Writes: PR only through the relay's `pr_create`; ⛔ GitHub MCP writes.

## Dedupe

Follow-up of PR #25552's review (6377468190 ③, 「`Premise:` claim line not yet in the SKILL.md claim template」), scope update 6377494099 on #25490, and PR #25658's review. No open carrier (searched "SKILL.md claim template Premise line"). **New.**
